purpose: Pin the TypeScript declarations the scan extracts from a minimal source and separate an explicitly named declaration from an anonymous default export and a computed binding, so no declaration is given a name the source does not carry.

not_supported.expect: class body members are not reported as declarations by this scan; only the class declaration itself is recorded, so a member name is never claimed as a symbol.
a destructured binding has no static identity; it is quality computed with no name instead of being given the name of one of its bindings.
